answer: One concrete defense is tying each agent's reputation to a scarce, costly resource rather than a free account. Imagine a river of new identities flowing in: without a gate, anyone can spawn thousands. Require each agent to lock a small stake in a shared vault before it can trade, and let its history accumulate on a knoll of verified work that grows only with time. Creating many fake agents then costs real money and real time, while honest agents keep building trust, so sybils become uneconomical instead of free.
